name: Wall of Slaughter: Frontlines
summary: The Muramite Legion’s forward assault line, where constant skirmishes erupt across Discord‑warped trenches and fortified positions.
description: The Frontlines are the outermost layer of the Wall of Slaughter warfront. Muramite soldiers maintain aggressive forward positions, launching continuous assaults against resistance enclaves. Discord corruption saturates the battlefield, warping terrain and spawning unstable anomalies. Trenches, barricades, and makeshift fortifications mark the landscape. The air is thick with smoke, planar distortion, and the roar of battle. This is the first and most chaotic zone of the Wall of Slaughter, where survival depends on constant vigilance and overwhelming force.
